summary: The dev-integrated T31 candidate passes the composed host, installer, staging, launcher, provider and packaged-history integration gate in a real full clone.
facts: Dev merge a8ca1adf924402c563f25fee2448c62adc123c67 was cloned with a real .git directory and passed 180 integration tests in 157.722 seconds with one platform skip.
The first linked-worktree attempt was not counted: its full-clone identity assertion saw the shared git common dir and its pre-existing source bytecode was correctly rejected by launcher integrity.
The passing full clone covered agent-runtime, installer, official staging inventory, launcher contract, dual-runtime/provider, packaged HISTORY and kb-aging consumers.
